desc: Dark and resinous: saffron and black truffle over vanilla, patchouli and oud, with a floral touch of crocus.

name: Tres Nuit
desc: Lemon, verbena and iris feel crisp and a little powdery. Lavender, spice and violet sit in the heart, with ambergris and sandalwood underneath.

name: Good Girl Supreme
desc: Wild berries add a bright, fruity top to jasmine and orange blossom, resting on creamy tonka bean and vetiver.

name: Virgin Island Water
desc: Bergamot, lime and mandarin sparkle over hibiscus, ylang-ylang and jasmine. A creamy floral heart settles into soft musk and light wood.

name: Rien
desc: A dry, dark leather: black pepper, saffron-leather and incense open it, leather, iris and cistus sit in the heart, and patchouli, vetiver and tree moss ground it.

name: A Drop d'Issey
desc: Almond milk and rose open soft, followed by lilac, jasmine and orange blossom. Musk, vanilla and cedarwood make a creamy, warm base.

name: Wonderlust Sublime
desc: Orange blossom, carnation and Tahitian tiare flower form a creamy white-floral bouquet that settles into an amber warmth.

name: Squid
desc: A salty, inky marine scent: pink pepper and a sun-lotion note open it, a black-ink accord and opoponax follow, and ambergris, benzoin and musk close it.

name: Musc Infini
desc: A soft, powdery musk: bergamot, grapefruit and ambrette brighten the start, rose and patchouli follow, and benzoin, vanilla and tonka bean make it cozy.

name: Red Roses
desc: Rose is the centre here, lifted by a squeeze of lemon and rounded with a drop of honey. Fresh, sweet and softly petalled.

name: Cheap & Chic
desc: Yuzu, orange and bergamot sparkle above peony, violet, water lily and rose. The base is soft with iris, sandalwood, tonka and vanilla.

name: Megamare
desc: Bergamot and citron open over a briny blend of seaweed, calone and hedione, drying to a mineral base of ambroxan, cedar and musk.

name: Tabac Blond
desc: A leathery, spiced floral that opens with clove and carnation, moves through ylang and rose, and settles on patchouli and leather.

name: Potion for Women
desc: Violet, blackberry and bergamot meet jasmine, rose and a green note of rhubarb. Patchouli, ginger, musk and vanilla keep the base warm and soft.

name: Pi
desc: Tangerine and pine give a crisp, resinous opening. Ironwood and benzoin follow, drying down to a smooth, woody warmth.

name: Le Male Elixir
desc: Lavender is warm and herbal over a heart of tonka bean. Benzoin brings a sweet, resinous depth.

name: Ricci Ricci
desc: Bergamot, rhubarb and a fruity accord open onto rose and tuberose, drying down to patchouli and sandalwood.

name: Un Matin d'Orage
desc: A stormy white floral: shiso and ginger start it, tuberose, gardenia and nutmeg bloom in the middle, and guaiac wood, myrrh and vanilla close it.

name: Chrome Extreme
desc: Green mandarin and a salty sea accord open a bright, clean scent; juniper adds a cool, resinous edge before amber and soft cashmere settle underneath.

name: Bibliothèque
desc: Plum and cinnamon open to leather and violet, over birch wood, patchouli and vanilla, like old paper and shelves.

name: Roses de Chloé
desc: Damask rose leads, brightened by bergamot and lychee and softened with peach and magnolia. Cedar and white musk give the finish a gentle, woody hush.

name: Arso
desc: A dark, resinous woody scent: cedar wood and leather lead into frankincense and pine resin.

name: Davidoff Adventure
desc: Bergamot, lemon and mandarin meet tea, pepper and maté, then sesame and spice. Cedarwood, musk and vetiver provide an earthy base.

name: Bamboo
desc: Orange blossom and bergamot lift a creamy heart of ylang-ylang, lily and jasmine. Sandalwood and vanilla leave a sweet, soft finish.

name: Kalan
desc: Citrus and herbs on a mossy woody base: blood orange and black pepper, then lavender, wormwood and orange blossom, with tonka and cedarwood beneath.

name: Candy Kiss
desc: Musk threads through every stage, with orange blossom at the heart and vanilla at the base. A soft, clean, skin-close sweetness.

name: Attimo
desc: Pear and lotus open onto a creamy trio of frangipani, gardenia and peony, with patchouli, musk and Virginia cedar to close.

name: Anaïs Anaïs
desc: Hyacinth and honeysuckle give way to a creamy bouquet of jasmine, lily of the valley and rose, settling into mossy oakmoss, vetiver and a hint of blackcurrant.

name: Hugo Woman
desc: Blackberry, cut grass and Italian mandarin lead into black tea, jasmine, plum and iris, drying to amber, cedar and sandalwood.

name: Psychédélique
desc: A patchouli-led scent with citrus on top, cistus, amber, geranium and rose in the middle, and vanilla and musk in the base.

name: Ta'if
desc: A spiced rose: pink pepper, saffron and dates open to rose, freesia and orange flower, finishing on vanilla, broom and amber.

name: Joy by Dior
desc: Bergamot and tangerine open onto Grasse rose and jasmine. Sandalwood, cedar and white musk follow, with a touch of patchouli for depth.

name: Lady Vengeance
desc: An aromatic floral with bergamot and lavender up front, rose and patchouli in the middle, and a clean, skin-like ambroxan base.

name: Sicily
desc: Citrus, apple and peach give way to a floral heart of jasmine, rose and violet, then settle into creamy sandalwood and soft musk.

name: Signature
desc: Mandarin, peony and orchid brighten a creamy heart of vanilla, magnolia and ylang-ylang, softened by musk, amber and benzoin.

name: Born in Roma Extradose
desc: Blackcurrant opens tart and fruity, then a boozy heart of rum. Vanilla rounds everything into a warm, sweet finish.

name: Poême
desc: Lychee and poppy open lightly fruity. Orange blossom, mimosa and jasmine follow, ending in a powdery, creamy vanilla base.

desc: A short, soft leather scent: ambrette seed and saffron on top, suede and ginger in the heart, finished with musk and leather. Warm, smooth and lightly spicy.

desc: A fresh fougère: citrus, lavender and herbs open it, lily of the valley and rose follow, and a long woody, mossy, spiced base of vetiver, cedar and ambergris.

desc: Pepper and cardamom sharpen a base of patchouli and ambergris. Earthy, spicy and warm, it reads like dark tailoring rather than anything sweet.

desc: Black cherry and black rose carry a sweet, shadowy glow with almonds, while smoked tea, licorice, patchouli and tonka linger at the base.

name: Angel Elixir
desc: Creamy golden florals sit in warm amber and bourbon vanilla. Rich and enveloping.

name: Narciso Poudrée
desc: Rose and jasmine take a powdery turn over a soft musk heart, with vetiver and cedar wood keeping the base dry and smooth.

name: Hawas for Him
desc: Apple, lemon and bergamot with a pinch of cinnamon; orange blossom, cardamom and plum follow, finishing on patchouli, grey amber, driftwood and musk.

desc: Rose and oud with a smoky, sandy edge: bergamot, fir, embers and sand open, rose, patchouli and black pepper follow, and oud, amber, sandalwood, musk and honey close.

name: Truth
desc: A clean mix of bergamot, lemon and bamboo meets peony, lily and mimosa. Sandalwood, vetiver and a soft musk and vanilla base keep it calm.

name: Monsieur
desc: A smooth woody-amber scent: mandarin and rum open to patchouli, then cedar, suede and incense.

name: Oud Mood
desc: Rose, saffron and pimento open spiced and floral, giving way to oud, caramel and patchouli. Amber, incense and musk wrap a resinous base.

name: Honey
desc: Pear and mandarin open juicy, followed by orange blossom, peach, apricot and honeysuckle. Honey, vanilla and wood make a sweet, creamy finish.

desc: A dark, spiced rose: apricot, cinnamon and bitter almond lead to Afghan and Bulgarian rose, and a long base of tobacco, patchouli, vanilla and ambergris.

desc: Pink pepper and lavender lead to geranium and plum. Mushroom, vetiver and cedarwood make a distinctly earthy, herbal base.

name: Love in White
desc: Orange opens softly over a powdery heart of iris, daffodil and magnolia. Vanilla, ambergris and sandalwood finish it warm and gently creamy.

desc: An oriental oud with a gourmand streak: saffron opens it, rose and praline soften the heart around the oud, and vanilla rounds off a warm, golden base.

desc: A smoky, boozy leather: pink pepper, whiskey, coffee and rum open it, leather, incense, tobacco and flouve follow, and oud, patchouli, oakmoss and amber give a dry base.

desc: Bergamot, grapefruit, pear and mandarin spark over apple, cedarwood and orange blossom. Vanilla, amber, musk and ambroxan finish it warm and fresh.

name: Vetiver Moloko
desc: A milky vetiver: bergamot and rose open it, a creamy accord and cypress sit in the middle, then vetiver, vanilla and amyris wood.

name: Amour
desc: White tea and rice give a soft, milky start. Cherry blossom, frangipani and heliotrope turn powdery over frankincense, vanilla and white musk.

name: Funny!
desc: Pink pepper, bitter orange and red currant start bright, with violet, jasmine, peony and tea. Amber, cedarwood, oakmoss and musk ground a fresh floral.

desc: Lemon and pink peppercorns start crisp, then incense and lavender lead to a warm, resinous finish of tonka bean and amber.

name: Néroli Amara
desc: Lime, lemon, orange and red pepper are zesty and bright, with cypress and pepper in the heart. Neroli closes it clean and green.

name: Amber Oud Gold Edition
desc: Melon and pineapple glow over a sweet gourmand accord, with amber, vanilla and soft musk rounding out the warmth.

name: Bellodgia
desc: A classic spicy floral built on carnation and clove, with rose in the middle and a soft base of musk and sandalwood.

name: Gentleman Réserve Privée
desc: Whisky and bergamot lead to a sweet, powdery heart of chestnut, iris and benzoin, grounded by cedarwood, vetiver and patchouli.

desc: Calypsone, pink pepper and bergamot open airy, then lily, jasmine and ylang-ylang. Meringue, patchouli and musk end soft, sweet and creamy.

desc: Orange blossom, mandarin and aldehydes open sparkling, then jasmine and rose bloom. Tonka bean, musk and vanilla leave a creamy, sweet warmth.

desc: Ginger gives a spiced start over a woody heart. Vanilla lends a sweet, warm finish.

desc: Lemon and mandarin shine first, followed by neroli and jasmine sambac. Musk closes it with a soft, creamy, sunlit finish.

desc: Lemon, bergamot and honey open bright, with fig, heliotrope and jasmine in the heart. Vanilla, sandalwood and musk give a warm, resinous base.

name: Bloom Nettare di Fiori
desc: Tuberose and jasmine take a rich, creamy turn with rose and ginger, set on musk, patchouli and the honeyed scent of osmanthus.

desc: Aromatic and dark: bergamot and pink pepper give way to saffron, praline and lavender, ending in oud, patchouli, vetiver and leather.

desc: Bergamot, lemon and orange sparkle, followed by rose, jasmine and juniper. Fir balsam, musk and ambergris end cool and resinous.

desc: Bergamot brightens a spiced heart of ginger and cardamom. Vetiver anchors it with a dry, earthy, warm finish.

name: Pour Homme

desc: Tangerine, bergamot and blackcurrant leaves sparkle over lily of the valley, rose and apricot, easing into a vanilla, tonka and musk base with cedar.

desc: Tangerine, lemon and pink pepper sparkle over currant buds, jasmine and freesia, ending on cedar wood, musk and clearwood.

name: Pasha Edition Noire
desc: Citrus brightens an amber heart, and cedarwood gives a dry, warm finish. Simple, glowing and quietly woody.

name: Higher
desc: Basil and pear give a green, juicy start. Cardamom brings a dry spice, and Virginia cedar closes the scent in a clean, woody line.

name: Escentric 02
desc: A fresh scent of ginger, citrus and juniper over orris and a hedione glow, grounded by ambroxan, musk, vetiver and tonka.

desc: A fresh, herbal gentleman's scent: bergamot, violet and green vetiver lead into coriander, juniper and armoise, finishing on amber, cedar and musk.

name: Miss Charming
desc: A sweet, fruity rose: Moroccan rose over wild strawberry, resting on soft musks.

name: Starwalker
desc: Bamboo, bergamot and mandarin feel airy, over elemi, nutmeg and ginger. Amber and sandalwood make a warm, spiced finish.

name: Soir de Lune
desc: Citrus and a touch of nutmeg and pepper open onto powdery iris, rose and mimosa, then warm into honeyed sandalwood and musk.

name: Playing with the Devil
desc: Blood orange and blackcurrant are juicy and tart, over pimento and rose. Sandalwood supports a fruity, spiced floral that feels playful.

name: Tuberóza
desc: A tuberose-led white floral with ylang ylang, sweet orange and orange blossom on top, gardenia, jasmine and marigold in the heart, and amberwood, vetiver, sandalwood and musk below.

name: Le Pavillon d'Or
desc: A woody aromatic scent: cool mint and thyme open it, fig leaf and heliotrope sit in the middle, and frankincense, oak and sandalwood give a resinous, dry base.

name: Oligarch
desc: Bergamot, lavender, lime and thyme open sharp and aromatic, with orange blossom, jasmine, coconut and lily. Cut grass, galbanum, patchouli and cedarwood give a green, woody base.

name: Guidance
desc: Pear, frankincense and hazelnut lead into saffron, rose and osmanthus. Labdanum, sandalwood, ambergris and vanilla make a warm, sweet and woody close.

name: Idylle
desc: Lily, peony, freesia and white lilac open as a soft bouquet, around jasmine and Bulgarian rose, with patchouli and white musk below.

desc: A salty, fresh leather: lemon, mandarin and pink pepper start it, clary sage and an aquatic accord run through the middle, and vetiver, marine leather and labdanum finish.

desc: Lemon, mint and dill open a bright, herbal top over lavender, thyme and anise. Leather, osmanthus and geranium lead to a soft base of vanilla, amber and cashmeran.

name: Narciso Rouge
desc: Bulgarian rose and red iris sit over a heart of musk. Tonka, vetiver and cedar wood give a powdery, sweet-woody finish.

name: Hawas Ice
desc: Apple, lemon and bergamot with a thread of anise run into plum and orange blossom, settling on moss, amber, musk and driftwood.

name: Evoke
desc: A classic floral-chypre feel: bergamot and pink pepper over rose, jasmine and iris, with oakmoss, patchouli and vanilla underneath.

name: Synthetic Jungle
desc: Basil and lily of the valley bring a green, dewy freshness. Jasmine flows into patchouli, leaving an earthy, creamy trail.

name: Quelques Fleurs L'Original
desc: A classic white-floral bouquet opens through green bergamot and herbs. Oakmoss, iris and musk end powdery.

name: Ra'ed Silver
desc: Tangerine and spices open into cinnamon, clove and saffron. Amber, ambergris, leather and agar wood give a rich, resinous warmth.

name: Divine Decadence
desc: Orange blossom, champagne and bergamot sparkle, then honeysuckle, gardenia and hydrangea bloom. Amber, saffron and vanilla keep it creamy and warm.

name: Spicebomb Night Vision
desc: Green apple, grapefruit and cardamom sharpen the bergamot opening, with clary sage, geranium, rosemary and lavandin, and roasted almond, tonka and cedar below.

name: Eternia
desc: Grapefruit, orange and pepper open brightly, then vetiver and frankincense bring a smoky resin. Saffron and sage close it, spiced and warm.

name: 212 Heroes
desc: Mandarin and raspberry brighten a heart of jasmine and orange blossom. Sandalwood and cedarwood add a creamy, woody calm.

name: Spice and Wood
desc: Bergamot, lemon and apple brighten a dry heart of clove, pimento, birch and patchouli. Iris, cedar, musk and oak moss anchor the base.

desc: Orange blossom and bitter orange mingle with the green, gin-like note of juniper berries, then dry out to patchouli and angelica.

name: Ambassador for Men
desc: Mandarin, apple and cardamom give a bright start, with lavender and pepper in the middle, then earthy vetiver, oakmoss and teak wood under a layer of vanilla.

name: Amethyst
desc: Raspberry, blackberry and blackcurrant make a dark fruit opening, with ylang-ylang, peony and rose. Wood, musk and vanilla finish sweet.

name: Layali
desc: A fruity floral with oud at its centre: dark plum, black currant and orange flower open, ylang ylang, rose and jasmine form the heart, and oud with amber closes it.

name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
desc: A resinous, leathery scent: bergamot, pepper, fir and laurel lead into rich flowers, then cade, resins, civet, leather, patchouli and vanilla form the base.

name: Turathi Homme
desc: Coriander, violet leaf and bergamot open crisp, then rose and pepper. Vanilla, patchouli and amber add a warm, spiced softness.

name: Madawi
desc: Pineapple brings a juicy brightness to a creamy orange blossom heart, which settles on earthy patchouli.

name: Blue Talisman
desc: A fresh, airy musk with juicy pear, ginger and citrus on top, orange blossom in the heart, and a clean, woody-musky base.

name: Oud & Bergamot
desc: Bergamot's bright peel gives way to cedarwood and a smooth, resinous oud, so a fresh start moves slowly into dark wood.

name: Flower by Kenzo Poppy Bouquet
desc: Pear opens lightly, leading into rose and gardenia. A creamy, woody base lets the bouquet linger softly.

name: Bergamask
desc: Bergamot and lemon sparkle, followed by lily of the valley, lavender and orange blossom. Cedarwood, musk and tonka bean keep it soft and fresh.

name: L'Interdit Rouge
desc: Blood orange and ginger lift a creamy heart of orange blossom, jasmine and pimento, which settles on patchouli and sandalwood.

name: Gaultier Divine
desc: Pink berry and bergamot lift a heart of lily, jasmine and ylang ylang. Meringue, patchouli and musk make the base airy and sweet.

name: Black
desc: Basil, mint and ginger open sharp and cool, then violet and cedarwood lead to a smoky base of frankincense, leather and musk.

name: Rose Pompon
desc: A fruity rose: raspberry, blackcurrant and pink pepper open it, Bulgarian and Taif rose with violet make the heart, and patchouli with white musk carries the base.

name: Chrome United
desc: Pepper, coriander and bergamot give a crisp, spiced start. Violet leaves and black tea add a cool green note before cedar and white musk.

name: Flowerhead

name: Eden Sparkling Lychee 39
desc: Blackcurrant, lemon, lychee and apple sparkle over rose, lilac and jasmine sambac. Amber, cedarwood, musk and vanilla give a warm, soft base.

name: Eau de Rochas

name: Replica Coffee Break

name: Juniper Sling

name: Infusion de Fleur d'Oranger
desc: Neroli and orange blossom feel bright and creamy, deepening with jasmine and sandalwood. A smooth, woody floral that stays serene.

name: Signorina Libera
desc: Pear, bergamot and elemi are bright, with iris, rose and plum in the heart. Sugar, cashmere wood and ambroxan make a powdery, soft base.

name: Blu Mediterraneo Bergamotto di Calabria
desc: Calabrian bergamot and citron shine over cedarwood and red ginger, then ease into a quiet finish of vetiver, benzoin and musk.

name: Cloud

name: Eau Parfumée au Thé Vert
desc: Bergamot, shiso and neroli feel green and light, with tea and violet at the heart. Iris and musk lend a powdery, quiet finish.

name: Noa

name: Boss Bottled Night
desc: Birch and lavender are dry and smoky, with a violet heart. Woody notes and musk keep it powdery and calm.

name: Osmanthus

name: Versense

name: Eilish

name: Escentric 03

name: Moscow Mule
